slots.metaTitle: Custom Sailor Moon Portrait From Your Photo | Anime Cabinet
slots.metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn custom Sailor Moon portrait from your photo. Preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, and magical gift-ready art.
slots.description: ["Turn your favorite photo into a custom Sailor Moon portrait with the elegance, sparkle, and empowering energy of magical girl art. A human artist hand-draws you, your partner, family, friends, or pet as an original character inspired by the style’s expressive eyes, flowing hair, moonlit color palettes, starfields, ribbons, and confident transformation-sequence poses. Your portrait keeps recognizable features such as your smile, face shape, and hairstyle while adding a personal guardian-inspired mood.","This is fan-art inspired artwork, not a traced or impersonated copyrighted character. You become the hero of your own scene, with details adapted to your story: moon silver, rose pink, or deep navy accents; complementary colors for couples; or individual motifs for a best-friend group. Choose a digital file or a custom anime portrait canvas for a memorable display. If you are comparing other styles, explore our [custom anime portrait Naruto](/portraits/naruto), [Ghibli-style portrait](/portraits/ghibli-style), or the full [Anime Cabinet collection](/).","Ordering is simple: upload a clear photo, describe your preferred pose, palette, background, and any meaningful details, then let a human artist create your first preview within 72 hours. Unlimited free revisions are included, so you can request refinements until the artwork feels unmistakably yours. For ideas on planning a themed print, read our [Sailor Moon-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/sailor-moon-inspired-custom-poster), or find more present ideas in our [gift guide for Sailor Moon fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-sailor-moon-fans)."]
